No API key required — call this first to understand the snapWONDERS ana

tools.name: vaultify_session_create
tools.description: Creates an upload session for hide (conceal a file inside a cover image/video) or reveal (extract hidden content from a stego image/video) processing. Returns the upload_uid and upload instructions. Upload each file with a single POST /api/upload carrying the file as the request body (hide needs X-U

tools.name: vaultify_session_files
tools.description: Lists all files currently uploaded for a stego session. Check that all files show status "completed" before calling vaultify_job_start. Requires X-Api-Key header.

tools.name: vaultify_job_start
tools.description: Submits options and queues a hide or reveal job for a session whose files have all been uploaded. Hide jobs support the full set of encoding options; reveal jobs only use upload_uid, password, and expiry. The call is idempotent. Requires X-Api-Key header.

tools.name: vaultify_job_status
tools.description: Returns the current status and progress of a hide/reveal processing job. Poll until status is "completed" or "failed". Requires X-Api-Key header.

tools.name: vaultify_job_results
tools.description: Returns download info for all result files once a hide/reveal job is complete. result_files is empty while the job is still processing — poll vaultify_job_status first. Requires X-Api-Key header.

tools.name: snapwonders_analyse_session_create
tools.description: Creates an upload session for forensic media analysis. Returns the upload_uid and upload instructions. Upload each file with a single POST /api/upload carrying the file as the request body; its response reports ready_for_job_start, so no separate verification call is needed before snapwonders_analys

tools.name: snapwonders_analyse_session_files
tools.description: Lists all files uploaded to an analyse session. Verify all files show status "completed" before calling snapwonders_analyse_job_start. Requires X-Api-Key header.

tools.name: snapwonders_analyse_job_start
tools.description: Submits analysis options and queues a forensic analysis job. Returns upload_uid and job_uid. The call is idempotent. Requires X-Api-Key header.

tools.name: snapwonders_analyse_job_status
tools.description: Returns the current status and per-item progress of an analysis job. Poll until status is "completed", "partial", or "failed". Requires X-Api-Key header.

tools.name: snapwonders_analyse_job_results
tools.description: Returns per-item forensic analysis results including overall_grade (A–F; the Authenticity grade — edited, generated or re-encoded), exposure_grade (A–F; what the file gives away — privacy and hidden data), face_count, text_region_count, and watermark_flagged. Returns job_uid which can be passed to s

tools.name: snapwonders_analyse_result
tools.description: Returns clean forensic result JSON by job_uid — file names, grades (A–F), detection counts, and analysis asset IDs (face overlays, ELA maps, etc.). The job_uid is returned by snapwonders_analyse_job_start and snapwonders_analyse_job_results. Requires X-Api-Key header.

tools.name: snapwonders_convert_session_create
tools.description: Creates an upload session for media conversion (images and videos). Returns the upload_uid and upload instructions. Upload each file with a single POST /api/upload carrying the file as the request body; its response reports ready_for_job_start, then call snapwonders_convert_job_start. Direct upload

tools.name: snapwonders_convert_session_files
tools.description: Lists all files uploaded to a convert session. Verify all files show status "completed" before calling snapwonders_convert_job_start. Requires X-Api-Key header.

tools.name: snapwonders_convert_job_start
tools.description: Submits conversion options and queues a media conversion job. Images and videos in the session are converted to the specified format. The call is idempotent. Requires X-Api-Key header.

tools.name: snapwonders_convert_job_status
tools.description: Returns the current status and per-item progress of a conversion job. Poll until status is "completed", "partial", or "failed". Requires X-Api-Key header.

tools.name: snapwonders_convert_job_results
tools.description: Returns per-item conversion results with asset_id for each output file. Use the asset_id with GET /api/convert/download/{assetId} and the same X-Api-Key to download each file. Requires X-Api-Key header.
